raw_comment:
1. I noticed that the exceptionally drought states or areas on the map are more scattered than I expected and there is a trend in the middle although I would have expected the exceptionally drought areas to be located around the south of the US. 
2. I wonder how long these states go on without rain to be classified as dealing with "Exceptional Drought" and why Alaska and Florida are the only states that are fully white. 
3. This relates to me and my community because I live in NJ in an area where it is constantly getting hotter and hotter every year and on the map it seems that we are getting close to experiencing extreme drought. 
4. How severely dry is the U.S.?
